scope: Unsigned native bundled encrypted-key chain and private agent/loader process cleanup

checks.embedded_core: dyld image path verified against each actual embedded framework
checks.key_type: Ed25519, unencrypted and OpenSSH-encrypted disposable keys created by bundled ssh-keygen
response_cases: Earlier loaded identity survives both failures
Correct one-use response loads encrypted key; exact public key lines match
checks.literal_paths: Unicode, spaces, single quote, semicolon and shell substitution syntax; receiver cwd is fixture; no sentinel created
checks.private_channel: Agent directory mode 0700; no credential/command files remain after calls
checks.live_abandonment: Controlled loader holds pending envelope while its child waits; session close kills/reaps actual bundled agent and loader group, awaits receiver worker and removes response directory
checks.fault_injection: Throw after loader starts; deferred session close and worker await complete; driver verifies registered agent/loader/child PIDs and absence of tg-agent directories before deleting root
checks.cleanup_driver: Emergency signals only positively identified fixture-owned groups, including registered loader child; any required emergency cleanup fails the test
checks.worker_completion: Deferred closure awaits the DispatchGroup on normal and injected-failure paths; timeout exits nonzero

limitations: No new shipping source changes or app builds in this checkpoint; native checks use the existing verified unsigned bundles
No main app window, physical passphrase sheet or real signed identity grant acceptance
No SSH server, network authentication, host-key/password handling, Keychain or PPK/hardware-key acceptance
No signed sandbox invocation, Intel runtime or macOS 13 runtime verification
No user keys or login-agent interaction; fixture passphrases omitted from output and records
Hosted GitHub CI unverified; complete TortoiseGit parity remains incomplete
